_metadata.description: Core closure, policy, archive, verification, and publication-safety obligations.

requirements.title: Deterministic source assembly
requirements.description: Equal admitted source and recipe inputs produce byte-identical ordered archives and manifests.

requirements.title: Fail-closed source safety
requirements.description: Private/history content, escaping symlinks, secret-like content, unresolved closure, and automated publication are refused.

validation.notes: internal/source tests and source handler contract tests

requirements.title: Exact artifact verification
requirements.description: Verification checks the exact archive digest and retains failed or unavailable standing.

requirements.title: Honest source contract
requirements.description: The recipe, manifest, runtime requirements, provenance, exclusions, and canonical ownership are explicit.

validation.notes: PRD, DESIGN, README, and source proto review

requirements.title: Durable distribution identity
requirements.description: Duplicate and restarted work preserves one distribution identity and its evidence references.

validation.notes: Scenario repository restart and duplicate-request fixture

requirements.title: Exact governance handoff
requirements.description: Readiness binds the exact artifact and evidence tuple and invalidates changed inputs.

requirements.title: Update and drift semantics
requirements.description: Source, recipe, and destination changes remain distinct and independent destination edits block overwrite preparation.

validation.notes: Distribution diff and drift contract fixture

requirements.title: Measured improvement loop
requirements.description: Quality sensors retain comparable closure, reproducibility, privacy, clean-build, documentation, and failure recurrence evidence.

validation.notes: Source-quality board and golden corpus review

requirements.title: Connector activation seam
requirements.description: A separately owned host connector can consume a human activation packet and return destination read-back evidence without receiving publication authority here.

validation.notes: Versioned Integration Hub fake contract; live activation remains operator evidence
